name: compare_periods
description: Compare two published snapshot periods for the same agent. Returns both periods' metrics AND server-computed deltas — never compute differences yourself.

deltas.recognized_revenue_pct_change: number | null (null if period A was 0)

returns.comparable: boolean — false if the two periods use different accounting bases or boundaries; if false, do NOT compare

rule: If comparable is false, say the periods are not comparable and stop. If a pct_change is null, describe the change in absolute dollars only.
